question: Which drug group's total cost grew fastest between FY2025 and FY2026 (in percent)?
model_sql:
WITH t AS (
  SELECT atc1_name, fin_year, SUM(total_cost) AS total_cost
  FROM monthly_drug
  WHERE fin_year IN (2025, 2026)
  GROUP BY atc1_name, fin_year
),
p AS (
  SELECT atc1_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN fin_year = 2025 THEN total_cost END) AS fy2025_cost,
    SUM(CASE WHEN fin_year = 2026 THEN total_cost END) AS fy2026_cost
  FROM t GROUP BY atc1_name
)
SELECT atc1_name,
  ROUND(fy2025_cost, 0) AS fy2025_total_cost,
  ROUND(fy2026_cost, 0) AS fy2026_total_cost,
  ROUND((fy2026_cost / fy2025_cost - 1) * 100, 1) AS growth_pct

WHERE fy2025_cost > 0 AND fy2026_cost > 0
ORDER BY growth_pct DESC
